name: IntlFlightListingSearch

parameters.help_en: The search mode. Default value: 0. Valid values: OUTBOUND (0, Outbound), INBOUND (1, Inbound). For a one-way trip, set this parameter to 0 for all legs. For a round-trip, set this parameter to 0 for the outbound leg and 1 for the inbound leg. For a multi-city trip, set this parameter to 0 for the first leg and 1 for subsequent legs
parameters.help_zh:
搜索模式，默认0。</br>
枚举：OUTBOUND(0, "去程"),INBOUND(1, "回程")。</br>
单程：都是0；往返：去程-0，返程-1；多程：第一程-0，此后都是1
parameters.name: search_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable external polling. If enabled, the external frontend controls polling to return more flights. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 外部轮询，外部前端自己控制轮询，会返回更多航班，默认false
parameters.name: out_wheel_search

parameters.help_en:
The query record ID used for external polling.

<notice>

This field takes effect only when out_wheel_search is set to true.
Do not pass a value for the first search. Otherwise, no search results are returned.
For each subsequent polling request, you must pass the query_record_id returned from the previous request. Otherwise, no search results are returned.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询记录id，用于外部轮询

<notice>

该字段仅当 out_wheel_search 为 true 时生效；
第一次搜索不支持传值，否则无搜索结果；
后续每次轮询需传入上一次返回的 query_record_id，否则无搜索结果；
</notice>
parameters.name: query_record_id

parameters.help_en:
The query record token used for external polling.

<notice>

This field takes effect only when out_wheel_search is set to true.
Do not pass a value for the first search. Otherwise, no search results are returned.
For each subsequent polling request, you must pass the token returned from the previous request. Otherwise, no search results are returned.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询记录token，用于外部轮询

<notice>

该字段仅当 out_wheel_search 为 true 时生效；
第一次搜索时不支持传值，否则无搜索结果；
后续每次轮询需传入上一次返回的 token，否则无搜索结果；
</notice>
